# Texas Technical Services

> Industrial automation, flow measurement, PLC SCADA integration, and inspection & testing company headquartered in Fahaheel, Kuwait with operations in Dubai, UAE. Serving oil & gas, refinery, petrochemical, power plant, LNG, water treatment, cement, and metal/steel industries across the GCC since 2008.

Texas Technical Services (TTS) provides engineering, commissioning, calibration, and maintenance services for custody transfer metering systems, process control automation, non-destructive testing (NDT), mechanical testing, and industrial plant automation. The company is an authorized channel partner for Mitsubishi Electric Factory Automation and distributes flow meters, analyzers, PLCs, VFDs, sensors, and field instruments from leading manufacturers.

## Services

### Flow Measurement & Metering
- [Flow Measurement Solutions](https://texastechserv.com/service/flow-measurement-solutions/): Custody transfer metering, flow computer configuration, calibration, validation, and metering system upgrades compliant with API MPMS, AGA, ISO, and OIML standards.
- [Flow Computer Configuration](https://texastechserv.com/service/flow-computer-configuration/): Programming and configuring custody transfer flow computers for accurate measurement and audit compliance.
- [Flow Meter Calibration](https://texastechserv.com/service/flow-meter-calibration/): Laboratory and on-site calibration services for flow meters used in custody transfer and process applications.
- [Metering Control System Integration](https://texastechserv.com/service/metering-control-system-integration/): Design, integration, and commissioning of complete metering control systems and skids.
- [Metering Expert Services](https://texastechserv.com/service/metering-expert-services/): Specialized consultancy for fiscal metering systems, custody transfer audits, uncertainty calculations, and compliance audits.
- [New Installation Design and Commissioning](https://texastechserv.com/service/new-installation-design-and-commissioning/): Engineering design, fabrication oversight, and commissioning of new metering installations.
- [Repair Upgrades for Helical Flow Meters](https://texastechserv.com/service/repair-upgrades-for-helical-flow-meters/): Maintenance, repair, and upgrade services for helical turbine flow meters.
- [System Software Upgrade](https://texastechserv.com/service/system-software-upgrade/): Upgrading metering and automation system software to improve performance, security, and compliance.
- [Upgrade of Metering Control System](https://texastechserv.com/service/upgrade-of-metering-control-system/): Modernization of legacy metering control systems with minimal operational disruption.
- [Validation and Uncertainty Calculations](https://texastechserv.com/service/validation-and-uncertainty-calculations/): Measurement uncertainty budgeting and validation reporting per GUM and industry standards.

### Industrial Automation & Plant Services
- [Industrial Automation](https://texastechserv.com/service/industrial-automation/): PLC SCADA systems integration, DCS, process control, and plant-wide automation engineering for oil & gas and petrochemical facilities.
- [Plant Automation](https://texastechserv.com/service/plant-automation/): Electrical and instrumentation works, new installation design, commissioning, and after-sales support.
- [Electrical Instrumentation Works](https://texastechserv.com/service/electrical-instrumentation-works/): Installation, termination, loop checking, and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation systems.
- [High and Low Voltage Cable Steel Structure Supports](https://texastechserv.com/service/high-and-low-voltage-cable-steel-structure-supports/): Fabrication and installation of cable support structures and steel frameworks for power distribution.

### Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
- [Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)](https://texastechserv.com/service/non-destructive-testing-ndt/): Ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, liquid penetrant, eddy current, phased array, TOFD, and visual inspection services.
- [Ultrasonic Testing (UT)](https://texastechserv.com/service/ultrasonic-testing-ut/): Conventional ultrasonic inspection for weld, vessel, and piping thickness measurements.
- [Radiographic Testing (RT)](https://texastechserv.com/service/radiographic-testing-rt/): X-ray and gamma radiography for internal defect detection in welds and castings.
- [Magnetic Particle Inspection (MT)](https://texastechserv.com/service/magnetic-particle-inspection-mt/): Surface and near-surface crack detection using magnetic particle techniques.
- [Liquid Penetrant / Dye Penetrant Examination (PT)](https://texastechserv.com/service/liquid-penetrant-dye-penetrant-examination-pt/): Surface defect detection for non-ferrous components and welds.
- [Eddy Current Testing](https://texastechserv.com/service/eddy-current-testing/): Tube inspection and surface crack detection using eddy current techniques.
- [Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing](https://texastechserv.com/service/phased-array-ultrasonic-testing/): Advanced PAUT for detailed weld imaging and corrosion mapping.
- [Time of Flight Diffraction](https://texastechserv.com/service/time-of-flight-diffraction/): TOFD ultrasonic inspection for accurate flaw sizing in welds and pressure equipment.
- [Magnetic Flux Leakage](https://texastechserv.com/service/magnetic-flux-leakage/): Pipeline and storage tank floor inspection using MFL technology.
- [Videoscope](https://texastechserv.com/service/videoscope/): Remote visual inspection using borescope and videoscope equipment.
- [Visual Inspection (VI)](https://texastechserv.com/service/visual-inspection-vi/): Certified visual inspection of welds, components, and structures to codes and standards.
- [Gamma Ray Pipe Crawler Inspection Systems](https://texastechserv.com/service/gamma-ray-pipe-crawler-inspection-systems/): Automated gamma ray crawler systems for pipeline weld inspection.

### Mechanical & Metallurgical Testing
- [Mechanical Testing](https://texastechserv.com/service/mechanical-testing/): Tensile, bend, impact, hardness, fracture, macro/micro, pullout, and air permeability testing for materials and welds.
- [Tensile Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/tensile-test/): Determination of tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation of metallic materials.
- [Bend Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/bend-test/): Ductility and weld integrity assessment through guided bend testing.
- [Impact Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/impact-test/): Charpy and Izod impact testing for toughness evaluation at ambient and sub-zero temperatures.
- [Hardness Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/hardness-test/): Brinell, Rockwell, Vickers, and portable hardness testing for materials and welds.
- [Fracture Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/fracture-test/): Fracture toughness and crack propagation testing for critical components.
- [Macro and Micro Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/macro-and-micro-test/): Macroscopic and microscopic examination of weld profiles and material microstructure.
- [Pullout Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/pullout-test/): Anchor, rebar, and fastener pullout strength testing for structural applications.
- [Air Permeability Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/air-permeability-test/): Measurement of air permeability for building envelope and material samples.
- [Air Permeability Test 2](https://texastechserv.com/service/air-permeability-test-2/): Additional air permeability testing services for specialized applications and standards.
- [Metallurgical Services](https://texastechserv.com/service/metallurgical-services/): Metallography, failure analysis, and material characterization for industrial components.
- [Metallurgical Services 2](https://texastechserv.com/service/metallurgical-services-2/): Advanced metallurgical analysis, corrosion investigation, and material qualification.
- [Heat Treatment Services](https://texastechserv.com/service/heat-treatment-services/): Post-weld heat treatment (PWHT), stress relieving, and normalizing services.
- [Heat Treatment Services 2](https://texastechserv.com/service/heat-treatment-services-2/): Specialized heat treatment processes for complex geometries and critical equipment.
- [Corrosion Control Services](https://texastechserv.com/service/corrosion-control-services-2/): Corrosion assessment, mitigation planning, and protective coating services.

### Inspection & Specialized Services
- [Inspection & Testing](https://texastechserv.com/service/inspection-testing/): Comprehensive NDT, mechanical testing, and specialized inspection services for pipelines, pressure vessels, storage tanks, and structural steel.
- [Specialized Inspection Service](https://texastechserv.com/service/specialized-inspection-service/): Customized inspection programs for specific assets, turnarounds, and compliance needs.
- [Lifting Equipment Inspection](https://texastechserv.com/service/lifting-equipment-inspection/): Inspection and certification of cranes, hoists, slings, and lifting accessories.
- [Lifting Equipment Inspection 2](https://texastechserv.com/service/lifting-equipment-inspection-2/): Additional lifting equipment examination services including LOLER and ASME compliance.
- [Exterior Windows Doors Curtain Wall Testing](https://texastechserv.com/service/exterior-windows-doors-curtain-wall-testing/): Air, water, and structural performance testing for building envelope systems.
- [Water Penetration Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/water-penetration-test/): Water leakage and penetration resistance testing for facades and building components.
- [Water Penetration Test 2](https://texastechserv.com/service/water-penetration-test-2/): Additional water penetration testing under varying pressures and standards.
- [Hose Test](https://texastechserv.com/service/hose-test/): Hose stream and water spray testing for fire-rated assemblies and windows.
- [Hose Test 2](https://texastechserv.com/service/hose-test-2/): Supplementary hose testing services for specialized fire resistance evaluations.

- [Water Treatment](https://texastechserv.com/industries/water-treatment/): Flow measurement and process control for water and wastewater treatment plants.

## Products

- [Flow Meters](https://texastechserv.com/products/flow-meters/): Coriolis, ultrasonic, turbine, vortex, and electromagnetic flow meters for liquid, gas, and flare applications.
  - [Flare Meters](https://texastechserv.com/products/flow-meters/flare-meters/): Flow measurement solutions for flare gas, vent gas, and environmental compliance applications.
  - [Gas Flow Meters](https://texastechserv.com/products/flow-meters/gas-flow-meters/): Ultrasonic, turbine, vortex, and differential pressure gas flow meters for custody transfer and process measurement.
  - [Liquid Flow Meters](https://texastechserv.com/products/flow-meters/liquid-flow-meters/): Coriolis, turbine, positive displacement, and ultrasonic liquid flow meters for hydrocarbons and process fluids.
- [Analyzers](https://texastechserv.com/products/analyzers/): Gas analyzers, dust analyzers, and continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS).
  - [CEMS](https://texastechserv.com/products/analyzers/cems/): Continuous Emissions Monitoring Systems for regulatory compliance and environmental reporting.
  - [Dust Analyzers](https://texastechserv.com/products/analyzers/dust-analyzers/): Particulate and dust monitoring analyzers for cement, steel, and power plant emissions.
  - [Gas Analyzers](https://texastechserv.com/products/analyzers/gas-analyzers/): Process and safety gas analyzers for refineries, petrochemical plants, and LNG facilities.
- [PLC & Automation](https://texastechserv.com/products/industrial-automation/): Mitsubishi Electric PLCs, PACs, HMIs, VFDs, AC servo drives, and SCADA software.
- [Custody Metering Solutions](https://texastechserv.com/products/custody-metering-solutions/): Complete custody transfer metering skids and systems for fiscal measurement applications.
- [Field Instruments](https://texastechserv.com/products/field-instruments/): Pressure, temperature, level, and flow transmitters for process industries.
- [Sensors](https://texastechserv.com/products/sensors/): Industrial sensors for position, proximity, vision, and process monitoring applications.
